name: anthropics-skills
description: Official Anthropic Agent Skills — 17 production-quality skills for Claude Code covering document creation (docx, pptx, xlsx, pdf), design (canvas-design with 30 bundled fonts, algorithmic-art, frontend-design), communication (internal-comms, doc-coauthoring), MCP server development (mcp-builder), web app testing with Playwright (webapp-testing), web artifact bundling (web-artifacts-builder with shadcn/ui), Slack GIF creation (slack-gif-creator), theming (theme-factory with 10 built-in themes), Claude API reference in 7 languages (claude-api), and skill authoring tools (skill-creator).
author: Anthropic

security_review.notes: Official Anthropic repo. Python scripts use subprocess with hardcoded list args only (soffice, claude --print) — no shell=True, no eval(), no pickle from remote. Shell scripts (web-artifacts-builder) use pnpm/vite tooling with no curl|sh patterns. Font TTFs are OFL-licensed. shadcn-components.tar.gz extracts to local src/ only.
